title: Run start
description: The harness's RUN_START record: what the run flies with (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §10.2, §11.1, §12; the Director's ruling on U21, 26 October 2026). A field with no subject is null (§16 U15): the stand-in has no provider, model, reasoning setting or endpoint, and a run may fly without a plan chain or a study reference.

mode.description: DEVELOPMENT accepts plans and acts signed with the test key; SCORED accepts only the Director's (§11.4).

provider.description: The provider as the run's model's adapter names it, since the adapter's code makes the call (the Director's ruling on U57, 28 October 2026).

model_id.description: The model ID sent to the provider, exactly: the model's frozen block in config/models.yaml, which its adapter's must match (U56, U57).

reasoning_effort.description: From the model's frozen block in config/models.yaml (U56).

endpoint.description: The base URL the run's model's adapter calls, which every run records (§11.1; U57). A SCORED run calls only the adapter's built-in endpoint; a development run may give it another.

answer_method.description: How the model answers (§11.1): structured output for spark, one answer-tool call for spark_open, scripted answers for the stand-in.

instructions_sha256.description: ODIN's frozen instructions, the prompt hash of §10.2, read from Muse Code's frozen record (the Director's ruling on U54, 28 October 2026); null for the stand-in, which renders no prompt (U15).

prompt_template_sha256.description: ODIN's prompt template, read from the same frozen record (U54); null for the stand-in (U15).

plan_chain_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (§4) list of the chain's plan-file hashes, in chain order; null for a run with no plan chain.

reference_sha256.description: The frozen COSMOS reference (§10.4); null for a run flown without it.
